achievements.name: No One Cared Who I Was...
achievements.description: Until I put on the mask.

achievements.name: Guns Don't Kill People...
achievements.description: Complete a heist after getting at least 50 turret kills on Hard or above.

achievements.name: Danger, High Voltage
achievements.description: Stun 4 law enforcers by destroying a Zapper's battery pack on Hard or above.

achievements.name: Unlimited Power
achievements.description: Have the EDGE, GRIT and RUSH buffs active at the same time.

achievements.name: Kitted Out
achievements.description: Unlock all mods to a primary weapon.

achievements.name: Arts and Crafts
achievements.description: Customize a mask.

achievements.name: Traffic Control
achievements.description: Complete Road Rage without the truck having stopped until the end on Overkill.

achievements.name: Crowd Control
achievements.description: Complete Road Rage without letting a single civilian flee, die or be traded on Hard or above.

achievements.name: True Connoisseur
achievements.description: Steal the painting by Shanda Latrell in Under the Surphaze on Very Hard or above.

achievements.name: Art Critic
achievements.description: Complete Under The Surphaze having stolen all art from the 7 exhibitions on Very Hard or above.

achievements.name: Color Me Surprised
achievements.description: Complete No Rest For The Wicked without letting a dye pack explode on Very Hard or above.

achievements.name: Just... One... More...
achievements.description: Complete No Rest For The Wicked having opened all deposit boxes.

achievements.name: Tech Mogul
achievements.description: On 99 Boxes secure both hi-tech devices at their maximum value on Very Hard or above.

achievements.name: No Stone Unturned
achievements.description: Complete 99 Boxes having secured the maximum amount of bags on Hard or above.

achievements.name: Closing the Account
achievements.description: On Gold and Sharke empty the vault of its valuables and secure all the loot on Hard or above.

achievements.name: The Hard Way
achievements.description: Complete Gold and Sharke in stealth without accessing the HR computer.

achievements.name: Cleanin' It Out
achievements.description: Complete Dirty Ice having secured all cleaned jewelry bags on Overkill.

achievements.name: Smash and Grab
achievements.description: Complete Dirty Ice within 120 seconds of spawning.

achievements.name: Party Crasher
achievements.description: Complete Rock The Cradle without having the VIP invitation in stealth on Hard or above.

achievements.name: Afterparty
achievements.description: Complete Rock The Cradle after surviving 4 full assaults on Very Hard or above.

achievements.name: Spec Ops
achievements.description: Complete Touch The Sky in stealth without killing a single guard on Overkill.

achievements.name: Insurance Policy
achievements.description: Complete Touch The Sky with 4 active human shields on Hard or above.
